description: Shared reviewed presentation facts and explicit claim restrictions. Source theorem fields and full certificate scope/evidence remain authoritative and unchanged. Exact source values may be interned; prose is never searched to infer implications.

policy.summary: Graph, weights and essential prerequisites appear once. Parameters and assumptions belong to details unless explicitly promoted to summary.
policy.claims: Every SOTA annotation, transfer and Tight application requires an explicit entry, including an empty conditionIds array. Show only claim IDs not covered by the active setting and its parameter bindings.
policy.sourcePreservation: Unresolved parameter and assumption paragraphs are retained intact as one interned fact each. Reviewed profiles may decompose their presentation; original source strings remain unchanged.
policy.largeTReview: For the factor-50 K₂,t algorithm, t≥2 is applicability and t≥49 is the conservative SOTA review scope. The broader pathwidth-two excluded-minor theorem covers that same Algorithm 5 with its O(t) schedule at H=K₂,t; generic H-dependent proof budgets are not equated by notation alone.
